evidence_kind: D38 unattended startup telemetry, experimental and final variants separated; no human presentation observations
host: Windows 11 x64, MSVC Release static CLI
source_fingerprint_scope: Uncommitted runtime variants at sampling time. Final confirmation and idle sources match the submitted runtime apart from seven direct standard includes added to url_playback_session.cpp afterwards; that difference was verified against the blob hashes. Regression tests were finalized and static/shared binaries rebuilt separately after sampling. Do not label the exploratory variant as the final implementation.

common_configuration.sender_stop_cleanup: each process exited 0 with cleaned=yes, failed=no and failed_reads=0; Enter was the end trigger

findings: Exploratory trial 1 (MRP) acknowledged the last queue command at 450 ms, reported URL playing/rate 1 at 767 ms and returned ready immediately. A paused state followed about 0.4 seconds later; status was owned/paused at position zero. Rate-only readiness was insufficient.
All four queue command acknowledgements preceded the first playing state in all 19 trials. This rules out acknowledgements arriving late in these samples, not every receiver ordering race.

The other five exploratory MRP and six minimal-remote trials remained playing in short telemetry observations. Trial order, sender idle and transient receiver state are confounded; MRP causality is not established.

Three MRP and three minimal-remote final trials confirmed startup after continuous eligible playing for 1002-1025 ms and cleaned up normally. No startup pause was observed in these six short telemetry runs.
One final MRP cast after 300 seconds with no native session confirmed at 2159 ms after first playing/rate 1 at 1138 ms (1021 ms interval). Its short telemetry observation and Enter cleanup passed.
The confirmation interval filters short contradictory URL telemetry but sends no recovery command and does not fix the receiver's spontaneous pause or establish ongoing decoder progress.
manual_observations: NOT RUN: user unavailable; all new visible video/audio/Home, remote Stop and sleep/wake checks are deferred in docs/manual-validation.md
limits: Playing status, scalar rate, extrapolated position, file reads and local HTTP body writes do not prove moving video or normal audio.
These are short sender-stopped samples; no new full-clip EOF or manual lifecycle pass is asserted.
Abandoned read-ahead I/O ends occur in successful earlier runs too; none of these samples had a source read failure.
Startup pause remains unresolved. Missing rate retains state-only compatibility; later pause after successful confirmation remains an ordinary pause.
Frozen-video issue retains low priority under D37 unless a later observed recurrence occurs.
All staged allowed executables were restored; no firewall, credentials or receiver settings changed.

local_validation.offline_runner_contracts: 10/10 passed before the final include-only runtime adjustment and test timing/name edits
local_validation.format: seven touched C++ files pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes
local_validation.scope: scripted peers and local tests are separate from receiver interoperability and visual evidence
